source.mission: SpaceX Inspiration4 (3-day orbital flight, Sept 2021), 4 civilian crew
source.timepoints: Pre-flight L-92, L-44, L-3; return R+1, R+45, R+82, R+194 (days)
source.method: Personal baseline = mean of the 3 pre-flight draws; SD = within-person SD pooled across the 4 crew (8 degrees of freedom). Because that SD is estimated from few draws, a single value beyond 3 SD happens by chance about 3.2% of the time (about 4 of 123 checks), so a single crossing is only a Caution: repeat the draw. Warning needs confirmation: the same shift in the whole crew (|mean z| >= 3, same direction) or the same person beyond 3 SD on two consecutive return draws.
